name: AMC Error Summary
description: A form frame that turns the item errors APEX shows inside it into a summary at the top, with a count, a link to each field and a plain-language fix hint, moves focus there once and clears itself when the errors clear.
useFor: Form regions and Static Content regions with page items, on pages that validate on submit or with apex.message.showErrors. Around a report, chart or text it is a plain frame.
helpText: Smart region template for forms. Design principles: error-handling UX says forms need inline errors plus a summary at the top that says what happened and what to do; feedback patterns say errors persist until resolved and the response must be accessible, not color only. How it works: the script collects errors that belong to this region from two sources and merges them per item: inline item errors in the body (an is-error field container, a control with apex-page-item-error or aria-invalid="true" and its #ITEM_error text), and entries in the page notification (#t_Alert_Notification, .a-Notification-item or .htmlDbUlErr li) whose link points at an item in this region through data-for, href="#ITEM" or apex.item('ITEM') in the link. The summary lists them in the order of the fields: the count ("3 fields need attention"), each APEX message as a link that scrolls to and focuses its field (apex.item().setFocus() when available), the field label when the message does not already name it, and a plain-language hint read from the message: empty required value, number, date format, email, length, duplicate value or mismatch. A Custom Attribute data-amc-hint="..." on an item replaces the automatic hint. Focus moves to the summary once when errors appear, also after page load when APEX would focus the first item; if the user is already working elsewhere, or with the No focus move option, the count is announced politely instead. Editing a listed field marks its entry Changed and checked again on save, without claiming it is fixed. When APEX clears the errors (apex.message.clearErrors or a new submit) the summary disappears; it re-scans after apexafterrefresh and on DOM changes. English strings to translate, on the section element in the template or per region as Custom Attributes: data-amc-label-one 1 field needs attention, data-amc-label-many %0 fields need attention, data-amc-label-intro Fix these, then save again. Select a message to go to its field., data-amc-label-changed Changed. It is checked again when you save., data-amc-label-this this field, and the hints data-amc-hint-required Fill in %0 to save the form., data-amc-hint-number, data-amc-hint-date (with %0 for the format), data-amc-hint-date-any, data-amc-hint-email, data-amc-hint-length (%0 = limit), data-amc-hint-toolong (%0 = characters over), data-amc-hint-unique, data-amc-hint-match. Hints are detected from English APEX messages; for translated messages set data-amc-hint per item or turn hints off. Keyboard: Tab reaches each link, Enter goes to the field. Reduced motion: scrolling jumps instead of gliding. Forced colors: the rule uses Mark and links LinkText. JavaScript API: amcTplErrorSummary.refresh(element), result(element) and hint(message, element).

templateOptions.name: No focus move
templateOptions.help: Keeps focus where it is and announces the error count politely instead, for pages with several forms or a form far below the fold.

templateOptions.name: Hide fix hints
templateOptions.help: Lists only the APEX messages, for applications whose messages already explain the fix or are not in English.

templateOptions.name: Sticky summary
templateOptions.help: The summary stays in view while a long form scrolls, so the next error is always one click away. Set --amc-tes-sticky-top when a fixed page header covers it.

templateOptions.name: Include page errors
templateOptions.help: Also lists page-level errors from the notification that are not tied to an item, as plain text, for pages with one form.

templateOptions.name: No body padding
templateOptions.help: Removes side padding around the items, for forms that bring their own spacing.
